observations.content: Appeal from Judgment of High Court of Judicature at Patna in Appeal from Original Decree No. 4 of 1941, arising out of Judgment of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh in Title Suit No. 45 of 1939.

participants.name_or_role: Gangacharan Mukherjee and A. N. Sinha

observations.event: Filing of Civil Appeal No. 73 of 1950 regarding mortgage and lease dispute.
observations.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 73 of 1950, High Court of Judicature at Patna.

observations.content: The question is whether prior to the enactment of section 65-A of the Transfer of Property Act in 1929, a mortgagor in possession had the power to grant a permanent lease of the mortgaged property so as to bind the mortgagee.
observations.event: Identification of the central legal question for consideration in the appeal.
observations.procedure_and_court: High Court of Judicature at Patna, Civil Appeal No. 73 of 1950.

observations.content: Raja Nilkanth Narain Singh mortgaged Gadi Sirampur to Chota Nagpur Banking Association in 1914. The Bank obtained a mortgage decree in 1921 and purchased a share in 1922. During proceedings, Wazir Narain Singh (son) granted a permanent lease in 1925.
observations.event: Chronology of mortgage, decree, purchase, and subsequent lease grant.
observations.procedure_and_court: Original Decree No. 4 of 1941, Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh.

observations.content: An agreement was made to set aside the sale if Wazir Narain Singh paid the sum by August 16, 1926. He executed a new mortgage to Court of Wards, satisfied the Bank's dues, and the sale was set aside. Plaintiff sued to enforce this new mortgage.

participants.name_or_role: Plaintiff (via Manager of Court of Wards)

observations.event: Settlement of sale, new mortgage execution, and filing of suit to enforce new mortgage.
observations.procedure_and_court: Suit filed February 4, 1929, Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh.

observations.content: Final decree for sale passed in 1931. Plaintiff purchased at auction in 1935 and obtained possession in 1936. Dilo Ram died; Hiraman Ram and Chohan Ram remained in possession. Plaintiff filed suit for khas possession in 1939.
observations.event: Execution of decree, auction sale, and filing of suit for possession.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh, Title Suit No. 45 of 1939.

observations.content: Denied plaintiff was subrogated to Bank's position. Contended decree was not binding as he was not a party. Argued Patta not ended by auction sale. Claimed partition occurred within a year of possession allotting property to him.
observations.event: Filing of written statements contesting plaintiff's claims of subrogation and lease validity.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh, Title Suit No. 45 of 1939.

observations.content: Held plaintiff subrogated to Bank's position. Found Defendant 1 was Manager/Karta and Defendant 2 fully represented in mortgage suit. Held decree binding defendants. Ordered recovery of possession and mesne profits.

participants.name_or_role: Trial Court (Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh)

observations.event: Trial Court judgment favoring plaintiff on subrogation, representation, and possession.
observations.procedure_and_court: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh, Title Suit No. 45 of 1939.

observations.speaker_label: High Court of Judicature at Patna
observations.content: Negatived constructive res judicata contention. Considered if Wazir Narayan Singh had power to grant permanent lease post-mortgage. Concluded lease did not render Bank's security insufficient under Section 66 of Transfer of Property Act. Held lease valid and dismissed plaintiff's suit.

participants.name_or_role: High Court of Judicature at Patna

observations.event: High Court judgment dismissing plaintiff's suit based on validity of permanent lease.
observations.time: Prior to Privy Council appeal (Admitted Jan 9, 1946)
observations.procedure_and_court: High Court of Judicature at Patna, Appeal from Original Decree No. 4 of 1941.

observations.content: Appeal admitted on January 9, 1946. Both lower courts found plaintiff subrogated to Bank and Defendant 2 represented. Only surviving question is whether Wazir Narayan Singh had power to grant permanent lease to bind plaintiff.
observations.event: Privy Council admission of appeal and framing of the sole legal issue.
observations.procedure_and_court: Privy Council, Civil Appeal No. 73 of 1950.
